title: 5-Star English Learning Resources Master Repository
description: Comprehensive local crawl and structured knowledge base of all 16 Five-Star (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5) resources identified in ENGLISH_LEARNING_SOURCES.md

resources.name: Cambridge IELTS Practice Tests (Books 1 – 19)
resources.description: The absolute gold standard for Academic IELTS testing. Authentic exam structure, raw-to-band score conversion, 14 reading question types taxonomy, distractor analysis, and complete Books 1-19 syllabus.

resources.name: IELTS Simon (Simon Corcoran)
resources.description: Ex-examiner minimalist method: 'Simple is best'. Standard 4-paragraph essay frameworks, Task 1 visual report templates without numbers in overviews, speaking frameworks, and 31 authentic archived blog lessons.

resources.name: Manchester Academic Phrasebank
resources.description: Over 200 academic sentence stems categorized across core research paper stages: Introducing work, Referring to sources, Describing methods, Reporting results, Discussing findings, Writing conclusions, and Hedging/Being critical.

resources.name: SKELL (Sketch Engine for Language Learning)
resources.description: Streamlined syntactic collocation engine. Word Sketches, syntactic object/subject collocates, dependent prepositions, and real concordance examples for core academic verbs and nouns.

resources.name: Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (LDOCE Online)
resources.description: Learner dictionary benchmark with Longman 2,000 Defining Vocabulary, syntactic complementation grammar patterns (V + -ing vs V + to-inf), and high-band IELTS theme collocation boxes.

resources.name: Academic Word List (AWL) by Averil Coxhead
resources.description: Complete crawl of all 10 AWL Sublists from Victoria University containing 2,542 word forms across 570 headwords, complete word families (noun, verb, adjective, adverb variations).

resources.name: Purdue OWL (Online Writing Lab)
resources.description: World benchmark for academic composition: Thesis statement formulation formulas (tension & causation), M.E.A.L. paragraph plan, transitional signposts, and wordiness elimination table.

resources.name: Dr. Geoff Lindsey (English Speech Services)
resources.description: Acoustic phonetics and Modern British pronunciation (SSBE). Why traditional IPA charts mislead, the GOAT/FLEECE/TRAP shifts, glottal stop /ʔ/ environments, intrusive /r/, and nuclear tone pitch movements.

resources.name: Rachel's English
resources.description: General American phonetics masterclass. The 4 American T sounds (True, Flap, Stop, Silent), stress-timed rhythm, vowel reduction to schwa /ə/, jaw drop, and chest resonance.

resources.name: YouGlish
resources.description: Search query operators (:us, :uk, :aus, #tag, "quotes"), 4-stage shadowing methodology (0.75x -> 1.0x -> simultaneous -> recording), and curated high-impact query packs for tricky minimal pairs.

resources.name: Luke's English Podcast (LEP)
resources.description: CELTA/DELTA extensive listening framework: 1-2 hour unscripted authentic episodes, natural discourse markers, idiom deconstruction, and latest harvested episode feeds.

resources.name: NPR (Planet Money, Fresh Air)
resources.description: Educated American journalistic audio repository: Planet Money economics, Fresh Air cultural critique, intellectual discourse markers ('As it turns out', 'What struck me was'), and episode transcripts.

resources.name: Aeon Essays & Psyche
resources.description: Long-form intellectual essays across Philosophy, Mind, Ecology, and Society. Model prose for IELTS Reading Passage 3 and Band 9 Task 2, counter-argument moves, and syntactic subordination.

resources.name: Toastmasters International
resources.description: Public speaking & impromptu mastery: P.R.E.P., O.R.E.O., and Past-Present-Future frameworks; Ah-Counter crutch-word elimination; and 5 curated IELTS Part 3 impromptu prompt themes.

resources.name: Anki & Spaced Repetition System (SRS)
resources.description: FSRS vs SM-2 modern algorithms, Wozniak's 20 Rules of Formulating Knowledge, and ready-to-import flashcard deck (TSV) with cloze deletions for Academic Word List.

resources.name: Business & Economic English (The Economist & HBR)
resources.description: The Economist Style Guide (George Orwell's 5 rules of lean prose), HBR Case Study Analytical Blueprint, and Master Macroeconomic Lexicon with high-tier collocations.
